name: source_fence_before_late_record
b:
DO $d$ BEGIN PERFORM no_release_test.record(); RAISE EXCEPTION 'unexpected_record'; EXCEPTION WHEN SQLSTATE '55000' THEN IF SQLERRM<>'publication_source_release_sealed' THEN RAISE; END IF; END $d$;
SELECT final_test.check('source_fence_before_late_record_b',true);
verify: SELECT final_test.check('source_fence_before_late_record_final',(SELECT count(*)=1 FROM listing_publication_private.source_no_release) AND (SELECT state='signing' FROM listing_publication_private.upload_grants));

name: source_record_before_fence
b:
DO $d$ BEGIN IF no_release_test.seal() IS NOT NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'unexpected_seal'; END IF; END $d$;
SELECT final_test.check('source_record_before_fence_b',true);
verify: SELECT final_test.check('source_record_before_fence_final',no_release_test.seal() IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM listing_publication_private.source_no_release) AND (SELECT state='recorded' FROM listing_publication_private.upload_grants));

name: source_duplicate_seal
b:
DO $d$ BEGIN IF no_release_test.seal() IS NOT NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'unexpected_seal'; END IF; END $d$;
SELECT final_test.check('source_duplicate_seal_b',true);
verify: SELECT final_test.check('source_duplicate_seal_final',(SELECT count(*)=1 FROM listing_publication_private.source_no_release) AND no_release_test.seal() IS NULL);

name: source_get_before_cancel
a:
DO $d$ BEGIN IF no_release_test.get()->>'state' IS DISTINCT FROM 'ready' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'missing_ready'; END IF; END $d$;
SELECT final_test.check('source_get_before_cancel_a',true);
verify: SELECT final_test.check('source_get_before_cancel_final',no_release_test.seal() IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM listing_publication_private.source_no_release) AND (SELECT state='recorded' FROM listing_publication_private.upload_grants));

name: source_busy_attempt_skips_to_other
setup: SELECT no_release_test.boot(); SELECT no_release_test.close(); SELECT no_release_test.boot('two'); SELECT no_release_test.close('two');
a:
SELECT 1 FROM listing_publication_private.attempts WHERE id=final_test.a() FOR UPDATE;
SELECT final_test.check('source_busy_attempt_skips_to_other_a',true);
b:
DO $d$ DECLARE v jsonb;BEGIN v:=no_release_test.seal(); IF (v->>'object_id')::uuid IS DISTINCT FROM completion_test.obj('source','two') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'wrong_object'; END IF;END $d$;
SELECT final_test.check('source_busy_attempt_skips_to_other_b',true);
